results.statement: Loc(6b) and Loc(6c) both fail for Wlc of every nontrivial derivator; both hold for the trivial derivator. All constant spectrum-homology localizers satisfy Loc(6a,b,c). For W1, 6b fails for every nontrivial derivator; 6c holds exactly for thin point coefficients.
results.hypotheses: Der1--4 on all small categories. Nontrivial means D(e) not equivalent to the terminal category.
results.proof: Double terminal cones; separate 6b and 6c cubes. Nonthin coefficients detect a regular action of an acyclic nontrivial group; thin nontrivial coefficients use two points and its circle suspension.

results.statement: For a nontrivial fundamental localizer, each of Loc(7a,b,c) holds exactly for Winfty. For an accessible fundamental localizer, Loc(7F) is equivalent to properness and to aspherical generation. For nonzero unital k, Wlc_D(k) satisfies 7F exactly when no prime is invertible in k, equivalently exactly when it equals Winfty. Constant Hk satisfies none of 7a,b,c,F. For W1, 7c holds for all derivators, while enhancement proves 7a and the 7F factorization assertion. 7b fails for the listed nontrivial truncated, stable, and thin theories; spaces give Winfty.
results.new_proof: Loc7F implies W=Wasph by graph factorization and the pullback lemma. General-ring nonproperness is witnessed by K(Z,2)->K(R,2), or K(Z,2)->K(product Z_p,2), with the target-locality hypotheses checked. Degree-one versions settle constant Hk, apart from the HZ-equivalent case covered by Cisinski9.4.7.
results.remaining_exact_question: For a general spectrum E not evaluated here, is Wlc_L_E Sp equal to its aspherical core? This is exactly the remaining 7F question. For an arbitrary unenhanced derivator whose Wlc accessibility has not been established, 7F implies aspherical generation but its converse is not asserted. For arbitrary unenhanced derivators, W1 versions of 7a and the factorization assertion of 7F remain unproved; the enhanced proofs use Wcoh=W1 and the homotopy-fibre criterion, respectively. Literal 7c is proved in full generality.

manuscript_precision.Loc6: Unqualified Loc(6) includes 6a and 6b. It must not be silently read as 6a alone.
manuscript_precision.Loc7: F_W is the Grothendieck fibration class with W-equivalent transport. Fib_W is universal strict-pullback preservation of W. Thomason model fibrations are a third class.
manuscript_precision.Loc9: XVI ms75: accessibility of W as a part of the arrow category. Under Loc8, section5.3 describes a filtered-colimit envelope of a small bounded-cardinality family. This is not aspherical generation.
